servinfo.title: B-Pillar Outer Panel, Rear Door Hinge Reinforcement and Center Pillar Inner Upper Panel Removal and Installation

attention3.ptxt: The figure below shows condition where the following parts are removed.

item.ptxt: Welding method and number of welding points are the same on both sides. This repair instruction shows procedure for left side.

The dimensions shown in the figure are reference values when cutting replacement part is placed on top of existing part. Determine the most appropriate cutting (or joint) line considering both size of replacement part and condition of existing part.
B-pillar outer panel (upper part) is to be reused.

s1.ptxt: Mark at the shown position and cut B-pillar outer panel.

attention4.ptxt: You may accidentally cut the parts under the B-pillar outer panel or the parts under the side sill outer panel when cutting the B-pillar outer panel.
Take sufficient care not to damage the parts under the B-pillar outer panel or the parts under the side sill outer panel when cutting the B-pillar outer panel.

s1.ptxt: Cut B-pillar outer panel, rear door hinge reinforcement and B-pillar outer panel at the same time at shown rough cutting position.
Drill out welding spots and remove B-pillar outer panel.

entry.ptxt: B-pillar outer panel cut position (Cut around here)

s1.ptxt: Drill out welding spots and remove upper part of rear door hinge reinforcement and upper part of center pillar inner upper panel.
Drill out welding spots and remove lower part of rear door hinge reinforcement.

item.ptxt: Before conducting any weld, check installation position and condition for installation part(s).
Perform repair while taking into consideration installation of parts that affect appearance.

s1.ptxt: Drill out welding spots and remove roof side reinforcement from rear door hinge reinforcement.
Install rear door hinge retainers (2 pcs.).
Conduct resistance spot weld or plug weld.
Conduct resistance spot weld or plug weld.
Install rear door hinge reinforcement and center pillar inner upper panel.
Conduct resistance spot weld and plug weld.
Install new B-pillar outer panel to vehicle body and cut in stacked condition.
Install B-pillar outer panel to vehicle body.
Conduct resistance spot weld or plug weld.
Apply anti-corrosion wax to back side of continuous weld part.

entry.ptxt: Conduct resistance spot weld as three panel thickness.
